entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No. 376/2014 of Police Station Kanjhawalan for offence under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no. 2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.

2. Adjournment requested by counsel for petitioner on the ground that petitioner and respondent no. 2 are unable to appear today.
3. Relist on 13.11.2025.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J AUGUST 7, 2025 'rs'
